ana: Quick sync  HarborBank POC: must-have list: SSO (Okta SAML), SCIM with groups, RBAC via AD groups, tenant domain allowlist, EU data residency. Also requested Dedicated pricing for a 3-month pilot and an RFI pack. Can SEs + ProdSec do 10:00 CET tomorrow?
mike: I can. Ask them to send IdP metadata and desired SAML attributes. I'll share our SAML quickstart link.
jordan: Options: Dedicated in FR/IE (2-3wk provision) or hosted + VPC peering for fast POC. Need their prompt size distribution to size KV cache and GPU memory.
ana: They want groups->roles mapping. Traffic: ~200 qps steady, 400 burst, 95th <100ms target.
mike: Example attr + mapping to give their IdP team:
```
<saml:Attribute Name="groups">
  <saml:AttributeValue>cn=rbac-admins,ou=groups,dc=harbor,dc=com</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
Mapping: `if groups contains "rbac-admins" => redwood_role="admin"`
sara: I'll own the RFI. Need their security lead contact and the questionnaire file. We'll include SOC2, KMS/CMEK details, SCIM/SSO audit logs, and retention options.
olivia: I'll draft commercial: POC discount for 3 months on 16-GPU reserved pool + hosted fallback pricing. Note SCIM rate impacts unless we run an internal sync client.
jordan: Operational note: recommend eager KV warmup and canary route to validate 95th/99th latency.
presales-bot: presales checklist updated: presales/harborbank-auth-playbook.md :white_check_mark:
ana: Next: (1) mike+jordan attend 10:00 CET kickoff, (2) sara owns RFI, (3) olivia to share POC terms, (4) ana will upload questionnaire + sample traces here. Posting invite now. Thanks.
